# Blueroll — blueroll.app

> Food safety management software for restaurants (UK, US, Canada). Digital HACCP
> checklists, an allergen matrix built from recipes, AI recipe import, one-tap EHO
> compliance report packs, incidents log and a multi-site estate dashboard.
> £24.99 per site/month, unlimited team members, 14-day free trial via the App Store,
> no contract. iOS, Android and web (app.blueroll.app).

## Product pages
- [Home](https://blueroll.app/): what Blueroll does, pricing, FAQ
- [Multisite](https://blueroll.app/multi-site-food-safety.html): estate dashboard for groups & franchises
- [HACCP Checklists](https://blueroll.app/haccp-checklists.html)
- [Allergen Matrix](https://blueroll.app/allergen-matrix.html): all 14 UK allergens from recipes
- [AI Recipe Import](https://blueroll.app/ai-recipe-import.html)
- [Compliance Reports](https://blueroll.app/compliance-reports.html): EHO report packs
- [Incidents](https://blueroll.app/incidents.html): complaint & incident log
- [Team Management](https://blueroll.app/team-management.html)
- [HACCP Pack](https://blueroll.app/haccp-pack.html)
- [For independents](https://blueroll.app/independent-restaurant-food-safety.html)
- [For franchises](https://blueroll.app/franchise-food-safety.html)
- [Trail alternative](https://blueroll.app/trail-alternative.html): comparison with Trail

## Facts
- Pricing: £24.99/month for 1 site, £49.99 for 2, £74.99 for 3; unlimited team members.
- Trial: 14 days free, billed through the App Store, cancel anytime, no 12-month contract.
- Compliance: records formatted for UK EHO inspections (HACCP/SFBB), FDA Food Code, Canadian provincial inspections.
- https://blueroll.app/haccp-template-cafe.html: Free HACCP template for cafes and coffee shops
- https://blueroll.app/haccp-template-takeaway.html: Free HACCP template for takeaways
- https://blueroll.app/haccp-template-bakery.html: Free HACCP template for bakeries and home bakers
- https://blueroll.app/haccp-template-food-truck.html: Free HACCP template for food trucks and street food
- https://blueroll.app/haccp-template-scotland.html: Free HACCP template for Scottish kitchens (CookSafe-friendly)
